variants.title: Under the pier
variants.premise: He is picking through a bucket of fish scraps in the shade under the pier.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Any chance of a ship out of here?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Depends whose boots you've got on.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: My boots?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Crews know their own. You're not one of them.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Try it. They'll enjoy that.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: None of them, not the way you're stood.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Something about the capital saying yes first.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Could have. The ship went. I didn't.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Never got round to it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Scraps come off the ovens at dusk. I'm all right.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Mind the nets on your way out.

variants.title: Boots and bells
variants.premise: He is sat with his back to a piling, watching a charter crew load crates.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I'm after passage on a boat.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That one's loaded. Sails at dusk if the captain stands.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Would he take me?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: He'd take anyone. The harbour won't.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: A lad tried last week. Came straight back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Proof of something. I only hear the shouting.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Fair enough.

options.label: How do you know the ships?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Boots. Every crew wears its own.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Yours have never been wet.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: All of them. Some start earlier.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Go on, then.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I'll be here after.

variants.title: The quiver
variants.premise: He is coiling a length of rope the crews dropped under the pier.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I need a ship out of Varlamore.

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The vagrant sits up and looks at the quiver.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: So you're one of the arena lot.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: The Colosseum, yes.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: That's the one. The crews talk about it all night.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Take it to the harbour in the capital. They read that sort of thing.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The one with the big book, down at the Cothon.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Registrar, I heard a mate call him.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Stepped off there years back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Walked out and never went in again.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: And do what? Stand about on a nicer deck?

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Fair enough.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Send word when you're out.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Don't come back this way. There's nothing here.
